title: SWE-Critix: Post-Training Generalist Verifiers for Assessing Coding-Agent Trajectories
abstract: arXiv:2610.13356v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding agents are increasingly deployed for end-to-end software engineering tasks, where a readily available oracle evaluator that defines the success criteria is often absent. This motivates verifications for coding agents that can reliably judge and explain their behavior. However, verification is non-trivial as coding agents are increasingly capable of solving long-horizon software engineering tasks. Their execution trajectories can be extremely long, containing hundreds of iterative interactions with code repositories and external tools. Existing verifiers either rely on general-purpose LLMs without specialized training or train dedicated critics that predominantly focus on producing scalar rewards, highlighting the relatively limited exploration of training-based generalist verification. translated_title: SWE-Critix：用于评估编码智能体轨迹的后训练通用验证器
translated_abstract: 编码智能体正越来越多地被部署用于端到端的软件工程任务，然而在这些任务中，往往缺乏一个现成的、能够定义成功标准的“神谕”评估器。这促使人们需要对编码智能体进行验证，以便可靠地评判和解释其行为。然而，验证并非易事，因为编码智能体解决长时程软件工程任务的能力日益增强。它们的执行轨迹可能极其漫长，包含与代码仓库和外部工具的数百次迭代交互。现有的验证器要么依赖未经专门训练的通用大语言模型（LLM），要么训练主要专注于产生标量奖励的专用评论模型，这凸显了基于训练的通用验证方法的探索仍相对有限。我们提出了SWE-Critix，这是一个用于训练编码智能体轨迹通用验证器的后训练流水线。给定一个任务及其执行轨迹……（注：原摘要不完整，此处仅翻译可用部分）
tldr: 提出了SWE-Critix后训练流水线，用于训练能够可靠评判和解释编码智能体在长时程软件工程任务中执行轨迹的通用验证器。
